description: This file defines a mock HTTP authentication handler class used for testing purposes within the Chromium project. It includes class definitions, enums, and method declarations related to simulating HTTP authentication behavior.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of HttpAuthHandler used for testing edge cases in HTTP authentication.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerMock::Factory
classes.description: A factory class that creates and manages mock HttpAuthHandler instances for testing.

methods.name: SetGenerateExpectation
methods.description: Sets expectations for asynchronous or synchronous token generation.

methods.name: set_connection_based
methods.description: Sets whether the handler is connection-based.

methods.name: set_allows_default_credentials
methods.description: Sets whether default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: set_allows_explicit_credentials
methods.description: Sets whether explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: request_url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the request.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the handler.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Determines if identity is needed for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials are permitted.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Checks if explicit credentials are permitted.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with challenge and SSL info.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenImpl
methods.description: Generates an authentication token based on credentials and request info.
